name: Festa Event Overview
query:
SELECT
    t.name AS "Ticket ID:Link/Festa Ticket:120",
    t.attende_name AS "Attendee Name:Data:150",
    t.event AS "Event:Link/Festa Event:150",
    t.booking AS "Booking ID:Link/Festa Booking:120",
    t.ticket_type AS "Ticket Type:Data:100",
    t.price AS "Price:Currency:100",
    t.venue AS "Venue:Data:150",
    t.creation AS "Booked On:Datetime:150",
    t.qr_code AS "QR Code:Attach:150",
    CASE 
        WHEN t.docstatus = 0 THEN 'Draft'
        WHEN t.docstatus = 1 THEN 'Submitted'
        WHEN t.docstatus = 2 THEN 'Cancelled'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Status:Data:100"
FROM `tabFesta Ticket` t
